Authored only from trusted_evidence_spec.md (005-U revision: 충돌 근거 표시, the conflict_records passed on the first call under contract v15, with the 005-T status retry, the 005-S cap and 005-R two-case paragraphs and section 6); the 005-T acceptance suite was read for format only (schema, case keys, registry shape, the expected block, mention-group and forbidden-pattern notation), the gate v16 constants and validate_suite for structure, and evidence_registry for content_sha256 and record_problems. No implementation, run output, test, review file or other suite's expected results were read, the pipeline was not run, and all questions, records and patterns were written fresh; other suites were grepped only for duplicate questions and reused names. Focus, conflict pairs (spec 4, 005-U): conflict-template cases, each with exactly two admissible records whose texts are the same except for one number once the leading [title] is removed (status codes kept), same person and case, status conflict, both records in must_cite and exactly two value groups, A05U-28, A05U-29, A05U-30, A05U-44, A05U-56, A05U-59, A05U-67 (ko 30, vi 29/59, en 28/44/56 and 67 with a Korean question; 28, 29, 30, 44, 59, 67 ask what each text says or gives). Not-conflict near-misses, expected answered: A05U-31 (two records, same text and same value), A05U-32 (two procedures), A05U-33 (sub-code only, codes kept). Partial traps, where the question adds a situation that is not an asked item so uncovered_items is empty and the status is answered: A05U-36, A05U-42, A05U-61. Kept from 005-T: cap positives A05U-01, A05U-03, A05U-37; two-case positives A05U-16, A05U-40, A05U-43; role reversal A05U-14, A05U-25, A05U-78; sub-code-exception negatives A05U-70, A05U-71. Ambiguities recorded: (1) Spec 4 (005-U) compares texts with the [title] removed; three records (A05U-57, A05U-58, A05U-73 abroad record) have no bracket title, and none of them is in a pair, so nothing depends on it. (2) Spec 4 does not say whether two records whose texts and numbers are identical form a pair; it says pairs are not given for 값이 같은 두 근거, so A05U-31 expects answered and citing both records (both support the one value). (3) Spec 6 judges conflict_treated_as_resolved by content, so no lexical 'applies/prevails' pattern was added to the conflict cases. (4) The conflict questions avoid 'document(s)', 'giấy tờ', 'hồ sơ' and '서류', which would ask the documents item (spec 4 table); 'each text', 'mỗi bên', 'từng văn bản' and '각각' carry the 'each document' reading. (5) Polarity and role patterns are lexical and sentence-scoped: a ban sentence with a cap, condition or hour figure is skipped, so a ban that repeats the number can escape; each was tested with a correct and a wrong answer in its language. (6) Mention groups assume the 005-S normalisation (lower case, whitespace removed); comma and dot thousand separators and number words are listed as extra spellings.
